verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
When you pass through the waters
I will be with you

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
And the waves
Will not overcome you

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Do not fear
For I have redeemed you

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
I have called you by name
You are Mine

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines: For I am the Lord your God (girls echo)

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I am the Lord your God (girls echo)
(I am) the Holy One of Israel, your Savior

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I am the Lord
Do not fear

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
When you pass through the fire
You'll not be burnt

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: And the flames will not consume you

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Guys: You are the Lord
Girls: I'll not fear
